message.chaospharmacy.cure.ok: One ailment gone. Doctors are shocked.
message.chaospharmacy.panacea.ok: EVERYTHING IS GONE! ...but you're weak after treatment.
message.chaospharmacy.hourglass.ok: Time sped up. The next ailment is here.
message.chaospharmacy.hourglass.fallback: Disabilities not found, so time just... sped up in your hands.
message.chaospharmacy.banana.slip: You slipped on your own banana!
message.chaospharmacy.ticket.cursed: The universe looked at your ticket and laughed out loud. ALL ailments are yours.
message.chaospharmacy.ticket.jackpot: JACKPOT! Healthy, lucky, and you got emeralds!
message.chaospharmacy.ticket.win: Ticket won: one ailment is gone.
message.chaospharmacy.ticket.lose: Ticket lost: here's a new ailment.
message.chaospharmacy.machine.jackpot: JACKPOT! The machine spat out diamonds and cured you completely!
message.chaospharmacy.machine.bad: The machine clicked and gave you an ailment. No change.
message.chaospharmacy.machine.good: The machine took pity and removed an ailment.
message.chaospharmacy.fallback.cleared: Disabilities not found, so all effects were cleared instead.
message.chaospharmacy.fallback.nausea: Disabilities not found, so you're just nauseous.
message.chaospharmacy.fallback.slow: Disabilities not found, so your legs just get tangled.
message.chaospharmacy.fallback.blind: Disabilities not found, so your vision just darkens.
message.chaospharmacy.fallback.tired: Disabilities not found, so you're just tired.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.nolist: The duck has nothing to diagnose: Disabilities not found.
message.chaospharmacy.oops.4: The doctor advised against it. You didn't listen.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.0: The duck heard your problem and silently judged you.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.2: The duck thinks mods are to blame.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.3: Try turning yourself off and on again.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.4: The duck sees everything. Especially your mistakes.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.5: It's not a bug, it's a condition.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.6: The duck recommends more sleep and less lava.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.8: The duck says: "You're fine." The duck is lying.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.9: Treatment: take a pill, then another, then ask the duck.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.10: The duck lit up everyone nearby. Now they know you're here.
message.chaospharmacy.duck.11: Duck's diagnosis: too much wood in your inventory.
message.chaospharmacy.cookie.glitch: Reality glitched: your hotbar got shuffled!
message.chaospharmacy.apple.msg: The apple was tasty. The consequences were not.
message.chaospharmacy.chicken.honk: BAAAWK. Did you hear that yourself?
message.chaospharmacy.dice.1: Rolled 2: you're the universe's favorite today.
message.chaospharmacy.dice.2: Rolled 3: lights out. Someone is saving power.
message.chaospharmacy.dice.3: Rolled 4: your legs run on cheats.
message.chaospharmacy.dice.4: Rolled 5: you're a fridge now. And more.
message.chaospharmacy.fuse.0: Oops! The upgrade fried your retinas, but your hands fly.
message.chaospharmacy.fuse.1: Gravity left the chat due to overload!
message.chaospharmacy.fuse.2: Boom! The upgrade succeeded... sort of.
message.chaospharmacy.fuse.3: The upgrade brought a bug: a new ailment included.
message.chaospharmacy.event.0: [CHAOS] The floor is now optional. Jump!
message.chaospharmacy.event.2: [CHAOS] The world tilted a little. Or was it you?
message.chaospharmacy.event.3: [CHAOS] Luck smiled at you. Don't get used to it.
message.chaospharmacy.event.4: [CHAOS] A ghost doctor removed an ailment. Don't thank him.
